method: Split completed final prose into factual atomic claims. Check support from its attached exact citation separately from truth against the supplied corpus. Record omissions separately. Review the seeded bad draft verdict against the explicit source statements. Labels are supplied judgments, not proved by the aggregation script.

limitations: Small visible maintainer-authored policy corpus, not held out or a general factual benchmark.
This session-assisted annotation is not blind human review or an independently metered native judge API.
Factuality is relative to the supplied corpus, not independently established real-world truth.
Missing final reports remain unscored for claim precision and count as failed native cases.
No superiority, reviewer reliability, latency or cost ranking is inferred.
